ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ss_config
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Configuration registers to setup system configuration. Usage is integration-specific; see the adopter chiplet specification.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: config_lock
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Written to lock down SS config. If bit 0 is written, then bit 0 of other SS config cannot be written to again

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: reset_n_n0_scan
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Subsystem active low cold resets

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: reset_n_n0_scan
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Subsystem active low warm resets

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: configuration_state_hold
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Used with warm_reset_n. Asserting ensures all registers configured during boot, including fuse values for export compliance, SRAM repair, other fuse values, etc. are preserved

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: sram_hold
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Used with warm_reset_n. Asserting ensures SRAMs, latch arrays and anything else that MBIST is used to test and initialize during cold reset are preserved

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: critical_signal_hold
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Used with warm_reset_n. Asserting ensures security, RAS, NMIs, perf counters, debug/trace and other subsystem specific registers are preserved

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: debug_hold
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Used with warm_reset_n. Debug hold signal to ensure any debug registers are preserved

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: reset_complete
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Response signal from subsystem to indicate reset (or some other critical step) has completed. Bitwise write 1 to clear

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cold_reset_lock
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Written to lock down SS cold reset. If bit 0 is written, then bit 0 of other SS cold reset cannot be written to again

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: force_ss_to_ref_clk_n
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Forces clock to be ref clk. The ensures reset reaches all FFs within a subsystem in same clock cycle

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: straps
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Strap value from GPIOs 0 - 31. Bit N holds the value latched on GPIO N. Bits 0 - 10, 16, 17, 24 and 27 - 31 have no strap assigned. Those GPIOs still latch their pad value here, but no strap function consumes it. Strap assignments in this range: * bit 11: CHIP_ID[3] - CHIP_ID is the I2C/I3C static address strap * bit 12: CHIP_ID[2] - CHIP_ID is the I2C/I3C static address strap * bit 13: BYPASS_SRAM_REPAIR - Bypass the memory repair process * bit 14: TEST_EN - Enable DFT test mode * bit 15: CHIP_ID[1] - CHIP_ID is the I2C/I3C static address strap * bit 18: BOOT_I2C - Default alternate boot channel is I3C0 and can be reconfigured to use I2C0 * bit 19: BOOT_RECOVERY - Use I3C0 for BL1 boot image loading instead of the SPI channel * bit 20: BL0_PLLCLK - Use the PLL generated clock by default in BL0, and override to use the reference clock when this strap is asserted * bit 21: STATUS_RPT_DISABLE - Disable BL0 status reporting. It is on by default * bit 22: SPI_USE_FUSED_CONFIG - Use the SPI configuration values stored in the fuse field * bit 23: CHIP_ID[0] - CHIP_ID is the I2C/I3C static address strap * bit 25: PRIMARY_CHIPLET - The primary chiplet has this strap bonded out to identify it as the boot master * bit 26: SRAM_AUTO_ZERO_DISABLE - Disable auto zero of the SMC SRAM when asserted

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: straps
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Strap value from GPIOs 32 - 60. Bit N holds the value latched on GPIO N+32. All bits other than those listed below have no strap assigned. Those GPIOs still latch their pad value here, but no strap function consumes it. GPIOs 61 - 64 cannot be strapped: they are unbonded (not packaged out) and lie outside this register, which ends at GPIO 60 (smc_pkg::NUM_BONDED_GPIO-1). Strap assignments in this range: * bit 22 (GPIO 54): MBIST_BYPASS - Ignore results of Power-On MBIST for boot * bit 26 (GPIO 58): ROTATE_UPDATE - Swaps primary and backup image in SEP BL0 ROM

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: sync
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Set to assert global sync bit

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: isolate_req_reg
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Isolate request. This prevents reset from being propagated to SS, keeping them alive in case of a cold reset

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: isolate_req_pinen_reg
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Isolate request pin enable. This enables the external isolate request pin to have an effect on ss isolate requests

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: isolate_req_smc_reg
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Isolate request smc. Asserted once cfg_flr_pf_active is asserted, de-asserted by sw

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: isolate_req_smcen_reg
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Isolate request smc enable. This enables the FLR lock to have an effect on ss isolate requests

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: isolate_req_pin
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Visibility bit for isolate request pin

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cool_reset_n_i
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Visibility bit for cool reset input

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cool_reset_n_o
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Visibility bit for cool reset output

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: isolate_req_flr_counter_value
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of cycles post cfg_flr_pf_active assertion is waited until cool_reset_n is asserted

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: isolate_req_flr_reset_counter_value
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of cycles cool_reset_n is asserted for. NOTE: The cool reset flow requires this value to be greater than 0; a value of 0 will prevent initiation, regardless of ISOLATE_REQ_FLR_COUNTER_VALUE's value

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_misc_wrap
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Top-level addrmap for SMC misc registers including scratch and chip config

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Scratch register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Scratch register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: version_lo
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: SMC version, lower 32 bits

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: version_hi
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: SMC version, upper 32 bits

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: chip_id
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Chip ID (e.g. 0 = Memory, 1 = CPU, 2 = AI Compute, 3 = Ethernet)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: lc_state
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Lifecycle state value from SEP. Default to invalid state

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: bank_chip
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Chiplet type ID

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: bank_instance
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Chiplet instance ID

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: ndm_reset
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: NDM Reset Control Register for communicating with debug module in each Ascalon cluster

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ndmreset_request
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: NDM Request from Cluster [0:NDMRESET_CLUSTER_COUNT]. Read-only field that reflects incoming NDM reset requests. Connected from ndmreset_request_i input port. Also connected to SMC interrupts. Supports up to 32 CPU Clusters

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ndmreset_process
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: NDM Response Firmware writes to this field to respond to NDM reset requests. Connected to ndmreset_process_o output port. Supports up to 32 CPU Clusters

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ndmreset_cluster_count
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of NDM Clusters supported. Can be read to mask the ndmreset_request register

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: gpio_intf
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: GPIO Interface CSR

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: core2pad
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Register-driven data to send to the pad.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: enable_rx_tx
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Direction control. 2'b00: Neither RX nor TX enabled. 2'b01: TX enabled. 2'b10: RX enabled. 2'b11: Both enabled

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: interface_enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Register Interface Enable. Setting this chooses register values to drive the PAD. This includes core2pad, enable_rx_tx, and pad2core

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: lsio_select
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Force LSIO interface to be used. interface_enable has higher priority over this

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: interrupt_enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Interrupt Enable.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: lsio_disable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, LSIO acceses will be blocked from the GPIO interface

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: interrupt_type
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Interrupt type - 0: active-high level, 1: active-low level, 2: rising edge, 3: falling edge

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: lsio_enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, this bit indicates that the pad being driving by the LSIO

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: pad2core
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: PAD2SOC Value

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: use_reg_core2pad
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Per-field register override. When set, core2pad is register-driven. OR'd with interface_enable.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: use_reg_tx
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Per-field register override. When set, the TX direction (output enable) is taken from enable_rx_tx[0]. OR'd with interface_enable.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: use_reg_rx
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Per-field register override. When set, the RX direction (input enable) is taken from enable_rx_tx[1]. OR'd with interface_enable.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ACCESS_FILTER
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: GPIO Access Filter Register. WARNING: please read back this register to ensure the filter was written correctly. If you do not do so the filter may not update before your next transaction, causing unexpected behavior.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: write_filter_enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Filter Enable - when set, only SEP may access the GPIO register interface. This effectivley makes the GPIO a SEP-only interface. WARNING: please read back this register to ensure the filter was written correctly. If you do not do so the filter may not update before your next transaction, causing unexpected behavior.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_filter_enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Filter Value - the value that must be written to the filter register to allow access to the GPIO register interface. WARNING: please read back this register to ensure the filter was written correctly. If you do not do so the filter may not update before your next transaction, causing unexpected behavior.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: awprot_requirement
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When write_filter_enable is set, only allow write accesses with this prot value WARNING: please read back this register to ensure the filter was written correctly. If you do not do so the filter may not update before your next transaction, causing unexpected behavior.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: arprot_requirement
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When read_filter_enable is set, only allow read accesses with this prot value WARNING: please read back this register to ensure the filter was written correctly. If you do not do so the filter may not update before your next transaction, causing unexpected behavior.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_avsbus_controller
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: AVSBus V1.3.1 Registers

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_CMD
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: The command+data to be transferred to the AVS bus

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write Cmd Data. Formats: [list] [*]Voltage (cmd_code 0x0): 16-bit unsigned int, 1LSB=1mV [*]Transition Rate (cmd_code 0x1): [list] [*]MSByte: Rise Rate, 8-bit unsigned int, 1LSB=1mV/us [*]LSByte: Fall Rate, 8-bit unsigned int, 1LSB=1mV/us [/list] [*]Reset Voltage (cmd_code 0x4): 16-bits, all zeroes [*]Power Mode (cmd_code 0x5): 3-bits, LSB aligned: [list] [*]0x0 - Maximum Efficiency [*]0x3 - Maximum Power [*]0x4-0x7 - Manufacturer-specific [/list] [*]AVSBus Status (cmd_code 0xe): 16-bits, encoded per AVS Spec [*]AVSBus Version (cmd_code 0xf): 4 bits encoded per AVS Spec, LSB-aligned [*]For read cmd_code's, this is 0xffff [/list]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RAIL_SEL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Rail Select: 0x0 - Rail 0 0x1 - Rail 1 0xf - Broadcast

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_CODE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Command Code (For cmd_group=0. For cmd_group=1, this is manufacturer-specific): [list] [*]0x0 - Target Rail Voltage Read/Write [*]0x1 - Vout Transition Rate Read/Write [*]0x2 - Rail Current Read [*]0x3 - Temperature Read [*]0x4 - Force Voltage Reset (Requires wr_cmd_data=0x0) [*]0x5 - Power Mode Read/Write [*]0xe - AVSBus Status Read/Write [*]0xf - AVSBus Version Read [/list]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_GRP
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Command group: Set to 1 for manufacturer-specific Command Code (cmd_code), otherwise 0

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: R_OR_W
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read or write type: [list] [*]0x0 - Commit Write [*]0x1 - Hold Write [*]0x2 - Read [/list]

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_READBACK
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Response data from AVS slave device (updated in response to both AVS read and write commands). Reading this register causes the AVS response readback fifo pointer to advance.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CRC
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The CRC-3 code received from slave

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read Cmd Data. Format depends on cmd_code in previous master subframe:[list] [*]Voltage (cmd_code 0x0): 16-bit unsigned int, 1LSB=1mV [*]Transition Rate (cmd_code 0x1): [list] [*]MSByte: Rise Rate, 8-bit unsigned int, 1LSB=1mV/us [*]LSByte: Fall Rate, 8-bit unsigned int, 1LSB=1mV/us [/list] [*]Current (cmd_mode 0x2): 16-bit unsigned, 1LSB=10mA [*]Temperature (cmd_code 0x3): 16-bit signed, 1LSB=0.1degC [*]Power Mode (cmd_code 0x5): 3-bits, LSB aligned: [list] [*]0x0 - Maximum Efficiency [*]0x3 - Maximum Power [*]0x4-0x7 - Manufacturer-specific [/list] [*]AVSBus Status (cmd_code 0xe): 16-bits, encoded per AVS Spec [*]AVSBus Version (cmd_code 0xf): 4 bits encoded per AVS Spec, LSB-aligned [*]If master issued a write (rw!=0x2) in previous master subframe, this field is 0xffff [/list]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STATUS_RESPONSE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 5-bit field indicating general condition of the slave, per AVS spec StatusReponse field: [list] [*]bit 4: VDone - AND of all VDone bits of active rails [*]bit 3: StatusAlert - Indicates potential status issue, requiring AVSBus Status read cmd for details [*]bit 2: AVS_Control - 1 if ABSBus is controlling at least 1 device output, 0 otherwise. [*]bit 1: MfrSpcfc_Stts1 - Manufacturer-specific [*]bit 0: MfrSpcfc_Stts2 - Manufacturer-specific [/list]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CONST0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Always 0

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SLAVE_ACK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates whether command executed or not - codes 0x1 and 0x2 trigger automatic retries by hardware: [list] [*]0x0: Action Performed [*]0x1: Good CRC received but resource unavailable - hardware will retry [*]0x2: Bad CRC received - hardware will retry [*]0x3: Good CRC received but bad data, data type or selector - no hardware retry [/list]

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_DEBUG_READBACK
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: This register mirrors the AVS_READBACK register, but reading it does NOT affect the AVS readback fifo pointer. Provided for debug purposes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_SLAVE_SUBFRAME
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The current top-of-fifo AVS slave response sub-frame in the readback fifo

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_LATEST_SLAVE_SUBFRAME
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: This register contains the most recently received subframe from the AVS slave, by-passing the AVS readback fifo. It is provided so that APB can see the current slave StatusResponse and SlaveAck settings in a timely fashion, since the status data from the next entry in the readback fifo might have considerable latency relative to when it was initially received from the AVS Slave.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_SLAVE_SUBFRAME
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The most recently received AVS slave response sub-frame

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_NORMAL_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Various Status bits indicating normal operating conditions for APB2AVS bridge block. These all have corresponding maskable bits in the AVS_INTERRUPT register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TOTAL_RETRIES
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Total number of retries attempted by the AVS Master

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_MASTER_IS_RETRYING
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Master is currently in the middle of retrying a failed command

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_FIFO_EMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates AVS_CMD fifo is empty

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_FIFO_FULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates AVS_CMD fifo is full - any additional APB writes to AVS_CMD will be dropped until the AVS bus can accept the next command, thus freeing space in the cmd fifo

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_FIFO_FULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates read-back fifo is full - no new AVS commands will be launched until space is freed by an AVS_READBACK access

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_HAS_DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates AVS_READBACK register has data ready to read on APB

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_BUS_IS_IDLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that neither AVS master nor slave is currently driving a transaction on the AVS bus

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_SLAVE_IS_IN_RESYNC
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that the AVS master is issuing a slave resync operation (34 clock cycles of holding mdata high)

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_SLAVE_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Contains the most recent status feedback from the AVS slave device

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_SLAVE_STATUS_RESPONSE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The 5-bit Slave StatusResponse of the most recent slave subframe received, indicating the general condition of the slave, per AVS spec StatusReponse field: [list] [*]bit 4: VDone - AND of all VDone bits of active rails [*]bit 3: StatusAlert - Indicates potential status issue, requiring AVSBus Status read cmd for details [*]bit 2: AVS_Control - 1 if ABSBus is controlling at least 1 device output, 0 otherwise. [*]bit 1: MfrSpcfc_Stts1 - Manufacturer-specific [*]bit 0: MfrSpcfc_Stts2 - Manufacturer-specific [/list]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_SLAVE_ACK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The SlaveAck bits of the most recent slave subframe received: [list] [*]00: Action Performed [*]01:Good CRC received by resource unavailable. No action performed (triggers retry) [*]10: Bad CRC received (triggers retry) [*]11: Good CRC received bit bad data, data type, or selector. No action performed [/list]

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_FIFOS_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Contains the number of occupied and vacant slots in the AVS master's command and readback FIFOs

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_FIFO_OCCUPIED_SLOTS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of occupied slots in the command FIFO

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_FIFO_VACANT_SLOTS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of vacant slots in the command FIFO

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_FIFO_OCCUPIED_SLOTS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of occupied slots in the readback FIFO

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_FIFO_VACANT_SLOTS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of vacant slots in the readback FIFO

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_INTERRUPT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt register - A '1' indicates an interrupt has occurred for that bit. To clear the interrupt bit, write to the corresponding field in the AVS_INTERRUPT_CLEAR register.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_SLAVE_ISSUED_INTERRUPT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates the AVS slave has signaled an interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_FIFO_FULL_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates AVS_CMD fifo is full - any additional APB writes to AVS_CMD will be dropped until the AVS bus can accept the next command, thus freeing space in the cmd fifo

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_FIFO_FULL_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates read-back fifo is full - no new AVS commands will be launched until space is freed by an AVS_READBACK access

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_HAS_DATA_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates AVS_READBACK register has data ready to read on APB

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SLAVE_UNRESPONSIVE_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates the AVS Slave device is not responding to command subframes from the Master

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MAX_RETRIES_ATTEMPTED_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that the AVS Master failed to receive a non-failure acknowledgement from the Slave after a command was retried the maximum allowable number of times (as determined by AVS_CFG_0:max_retries)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_FIFO_OVERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that an APB write to AVS_CMD was attempted when the the command fifo was already full - the command is dropped

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_UNDERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that an APB read on the AVS_READBACK reg occurred when the readback fifo was empty (AVS_NORMAL_STATUS:readback_has_data=0)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_OVERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that the response from AVS slave could not be written to readback FIFO due to it being full => response was dropped

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_INTERRUPT_MASK
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt mask register - Determines which AVS_INTERRUPT bits can trigger an interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_AVS_SLAVE_ISSUED_INTERRUPT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable notification of AVS slave interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_CMD_FIFO_FULL_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable cmd_fifo_full interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_READBACK_FIFO_FULL_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable readback_fifo_full interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_READBACK_HAS_DATA_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable readback_has_data interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_SLAVE_UNRESPONSIVE_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable slave_unresponsive interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_MAX_RETRIES_ATTEMPTED_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable max_retries_attempted interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_CMD_FIFO_OVERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable cmd_fifo_overflow interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_READBACK_UNDERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable readback_underflow interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_READBACK_OVERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable readback_overflow interrupt

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_INTERRUPT_CLEAR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Write 1 to clear corresponding interrupt bit

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_AVS_SLAVE_ISSUED_INTERRUPT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear avs_slave_issued_interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_CMD_FIFO_FULL_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear cmd_fifo_full interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_READBACK_FIFO_FULL_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear readback_fifo_full interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_READBACK_HAS_DATA_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear readback_has_data interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_SLAVE_UNRESPONSIVE_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear slave_unresponsive interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_MAX_RETRIES_ATTEMPTED_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear max_retries_attempted interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_CMD_FIFO_OVERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear cmd_fifo_overflow interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_READBACK_UNDERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear readback_underflow interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_READBACK_OVERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear readback_overflow interrupt

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_CFG_0
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Configuration register for APB2AVS bridge block

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RESYNC_INTERVAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Max interval to issue slave resync operation on AVS bus, expressed in number of APB clock cycles. NOTE: there is a 3 cycle delay for the resync flag to be seen by the avs controller due to synchronization.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MAX_RETRIES
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Maximum number of times to attempt a retry if an AVS command returns a fail status (either due to targetted resource being busy or CRC failure)

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_CFG_1
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Configuration register for APB2AVS bridge block

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_CLOCK_SELECT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Selects which clock to use for AVS Clock: [list] [*] 00: Use the APB clock directly as the AVS clock [*] 01: Use a divided version of APB clock as the AVS Clock. The clock divider settings are determined by AVS_CFG_1:clk_divider_value and AVS_CFG_1:clk_divider_duty_cycle_numerator [*] 10: Use the refclk clock directly as the AVS clock [*] 11: Use a divided version of refclk clock as the AVS Clock. The clock divider settings are determined by AVS_CFG_1:clk_divider_value and AVS_CFG_1:clk_divider_duty_cycle_numerator [/list]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STOP_AVS_CLOCK_ON_IDLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When the AVS bus is idle, gate the avs_clock from running. Restart it when there are new commands to be run. The master will always first issue 34 slave-resync cycles when the clock first restarts.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FORCE_SLAVE_RESYNC_OPERATION
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Force master to issue a slave resync (34 clock cycles of holding the mdata signal high) at the next possible opportunity. NOTE: there is a 3 cycle delay for the resync flag to be seen by the avs controller due to synchronization.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TURN_OFF_ALL_PREMUX_CLOCKS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Gate off all clocks entering the AVS clock mux - do this before changing the mux selection or changing the clock divider settings, then turn back on afterwards

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLK_DIVIDER_VALUE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Determines the divisor value used to generate the AVS clock (when avs_clock_select is set to select the divided APB clock or divided refclk clock). The duty cycle of the divided clock depends both on the clk_divider_value together with the clk_divider_duty_cycle_numerator value. A 50% duty cycle is only possible on even clk_divider_values with clk_divider_duty_cycle_numerator set to 128. This field requires a minimum value of 2 - for lower values, 2 will be assumed. This is set to 0 by default to trick the clock divider into maintaining the HW-default settings (divider=0x4) by matching the FF default in the resynced version of the signal.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLK_DIVIDER_DUTY_CYCLE_NUMERATOR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Determines the desired duty cycle of the divided clock (when avs_clock_select is set to select the divided APB clock or refclk clock). This value will be divided by 256 to determine the high-pulse percentage of the divided clock period. Depending on the clk_divider_value, it may not be possible to precisely achieve the desired duty cycle - in that case, the closest possible fit is used. If this is set to 0, a value of 1 will be assumed. This is set to 0 by default to trick the clock divider into maintaining the HW-default settings (numerator=0x80) by matching the FF default in the resynced version of the signal.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_CONFIG
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: AVS Configuration Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_GPIO_ENABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable AVSBus connection to GPIOs. The effective sets OE of the GPIOs dedicated to avs_clock and avs_cdata to 1, sets IE of GPIO dedicated to avs_tdata to 1. By default, this is enabled as the AVSBus state machine immediately starts after reset deassertion.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_STATE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FMT_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: remains asserted while the Controller TX FIFO level is less than `HOST_FIFO_CONFIG.FMT_THRESH`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: remains asserted while the Controller RX FIFO level is greater than `HOST_FIFO_CONFIG.RX_THRESH`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQ_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: remains asserted while the Target RX FIFO level is greater than `TARGET_FIFO_CONFIG.ACQ_THRESH`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_OVERFLOW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when the Controller RX FIFO overflows. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CONTROLLER_HALT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: remains asserted while this controller halts. The flags in the `CONTROLLER_EVENTS` register explain the reason(s) for the halting. Clearing the `CONTROLLER_EVENTS` flags clears this interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SCL_INTERFERENCE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when SCL is unexpectedly pulled LOW by another controller. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SDA_INTERFERENCE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when SDA is unexpectedly pulled LOW by another controller. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STRETCH_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when the target stretches the clock longer than `TIMEOUT_CTRL.VAL` (valid only when `TIMEOUT_CTRL.MODE = 0`). Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SDA_UNSTABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when the target fails to keep SDA stable during a transmission. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_COMPLETE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller/Target Mode interrupt: asserted when this/the controller finishes generating a STOP or repeated START. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_STRETCH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: remains asserted while this target is stretching the clock or has halted. The flags in the `TARGET_EVENTS` register explain the reason(s) for clock stretching/halting. Clearing the `TARGET_EVENTS` flags clears this interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: remains asserted while the Target TX FIFO level is less than `TARGET_FIFO_CONFIG.TX_THRESH`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQ_STRETCH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: remains asserted while the target is stretching the clock because 1) the Target RX FIFO is full or 2) the `TARGET_ACK_CTRL.NBYTES` count has reached `0` (only if `CTRL.ACK_CTRL_EN = 1`).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: UNEXP_STOP
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: asserted when the controller sends this target a STOP before this target NACKs. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: HOST_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: asserted when the controller stops generating the clock longer than `HOST_TIMEOUT_CTRL.VAL`. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SMBALERT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when `smbalert_ni` is asserted. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CONTROLLER_TX_FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when the Controller TX FIFO has a parity error. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CONTROLLER_RX_FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when the Controller RX FIFO has a parity error. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TARGET_TX_FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: asserted when the Target TX FIFO has a parity error. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TARGET_RX_FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: asserted when the Target RX FIFO has a parity error. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_ENABLE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Enable Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FMT_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `FMT_THRESHOLD` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `RX_THRESHOLD` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQ_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `ACQ_THRESHOLD` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_OVERFLOW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `RX_OVERFLOW` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CONTROLLER_HALT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `CONTROLLER_HALT` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SCL_INTERFERENCE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `SCL_INTERFERENCE` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SDA_INTERFERENCE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `SDA_INTERFERENCE` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STRETCH_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `STRETCH_TIMEOUT` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SDA_UNSTABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `SDA_UNSTABLE` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_COMPLETE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `CMD_COMPLETE` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_STRETCH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `TX_STRETCH` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `TX_THRESHOLD` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQ_STRETCH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `ACQ_STRETCH` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: UNEXP_STOP
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `UNEXP_STOP` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: HOST_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `HOST_TIMEOUT` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SMBALERT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `SMBALERT` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CONTROLLER_TX_FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `CONTROLLER_TX_FIFO_ERROR` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CONTROLLER_RX_FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `CONTROLLER_RX_FIFO_ERROR` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TARGET_TX_FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `TARGET_TX_FIFO_ERROR` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TARGET_RX_FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `TARGET_RX_FIFO_ERROR` interrupt.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_TEST
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Test Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FMT_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing `1` forces the `FMT_THRESHOLD` interrupt. Writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing `1` forces the `RX_THRESHOLD` interrupt. Writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQ_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing `1` forces the `ACQ_THRESHOLD` interrupt. Writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_OVERFLOW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing `1` forces the `RX_OVERFLOW` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CONTROLLER_HALT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing `1` forces the `CONTROLLER_HALT` interrupt. Writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SCL_INTERFERENCE

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SDA_INTERFERENCE

ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing `1` forces the `STRETCH_TIMEOUT` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SDA_UNSTABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing `1` forces the `SDA_UNSTABLE` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_COMPLETE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing `1` forces the `CMD_COMPLETE` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_STRETCH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing `1` forces the `TX_STRETCH` interrupt. Writing a `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing `1` forces the `TX_THRESHOLD` interrupt. Writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQ_STRETCH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing `1` forces the `ACQ_STRETCH` interrupt. Writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: UNEXP_STOP
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing `1` forces the `UNEXP_STOP` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: HOST_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing `1` forces the `HOST_TIMEOUT` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SMBALERT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing `1` forces the `SMBALERT` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CONTROLLER_TX_FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing `1` forces the `CONTROLLER_TX_FIFO_ERROR` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CONTROLLER_RX_FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing `1` forces the `CONTROLLER_RX_FIFO_ERROR` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TARGET_TX_FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing `1` forces the `TARGET_TX_FIFO_ERROR` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TARGET_RX_FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing `1` forces the `TARGET_RX_FIFO_ERROR` interrupt.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SMBUS_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: SMBus Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SMBSUS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode control: asserts the `smbsus_no` output.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SMBALERT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode control: asserts the `smbalert_no` output. This bit clears itself when the controller addresses this target.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ENABLEHOST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: configures this device's operating mode. * `ENABLEHOST = 1` and `ENABLETARGET = 0` — Controller Mode * `ENABLEHOST = 0` and `ENABLETARGET = 1` — Target Mode * `ENABLEHOST = 1` and `ENABLETARGET = 1` — Hybrid Mode * `ENABLEHOST = 0` and `ENABLETARGET = 0` — Monitor Mode

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ENABLETARGET
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: configures this device's operating mode. * `ENABLEHOST = 1` and `ENABLETARGET = 0` — Controller Mode * `ENABLEHOST = 0` and `ENABLETARGET = 1` — Target Mode * `ENABLEHOST = 1` and `ENABLETARGET = 1` — Hybrid Mode * `ENABLEHOST = 0` and `ENABLETARGET = 0` — Monitor Mode

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LLPBK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: enables line loop-back. In Controller Mode, the internal logic sees the `smbalert_ni` input as deasserted. In Target Mode, this target sends all received SDA data back out, and the internal logic sees received data as all 1's.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: NACK_ADDR_AFTER_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode control: NACK address after timeout. If this bit is: * `0` - This target ACKs the address byte even if a Stretch Timeout occurs (useful for SMBus). * `1` - This target NACKs the address byte when a Stretch Timeout occurs.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACK_CTRL_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode control: enables the Software ACK Control Mechanism. If this bit is: * `0` - This target ACKs a data byte whenever the ACQ FIFO has space. * `1` - This target ACKs the first `TARGET_ACK_CTRL.NBYTES` bytes. If another byte arrives, this target stretches the clock and awaits software intervention (and asserts `STATUS.ACK_CTRL_STRETCH`). The software can 1. accept the new byte(s) by reloading the `TARGET_ACK_CTRL.NBYTES` counter; or 2. reject the new byte(s) by writing `1` to `TARGET_ACK_CTRL.NACK` (useful for SMBus).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MULTI_CONTROLLER_MONITOR_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Global control: enables the Bus Monitor. Set this bit to `1` only in a multi-controller environment.
If a `0`->`1` transition happens while `ENABLEHOST` and `ENABLETARGET` are both `0`, the Bus Monitor will enable and begin in the 'Bus Busy' state. To transition to a 'Bus Free' state, `HOST_TIMEOUT_CTRL` must be nonzero so the Bus Monitor may count out idle cycles to confirm the freedom to transmit. In addition, the Bus Monitor will track whether the bus is free based on the enabled timeouts and detected STOP symbols. For Multi-Controller Mode, ensure `MULTI_CONTROLLER_MONITOR_EN` becomes `1` no later than `ENABLEHOST` or `ENABLETARGET`. This bit can be set at the same time as either or both of the other two, though.
Note that if `MULTI_CONTROLLER_MONITOR_EN` is set after `ENABLEHOST` or `ENABLETARGET`, the Bus Monitor will begin in the 'Bus Free' state instead. This would violate the proper protocol for a controller to join a multi-controller environment. However, if this controller is known to be the first to join, this ordering will enable skipping the idle wait.
When `0`, the bus monitor will report that the bus is always free, so the Controller FSM is never blocked from transmitting.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_STRETCH_CTRL_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target mode control: enables the Software TX Stretch Control Mechanism. If this bit is: * `0` - Automatic TX Stretch: When this target receives a READ address byte, it only stretches the clock if the TX FIFO is empty; otherwise, it pops the FIFO and transmits the data byte. The target never sets the `TARGET_EVENTS` register flags in this mode. * `1` - Software TX Stretch Mode: When this target receives a READ address, it always stretches the clock and sets the `TARGET_EVENTS.TX_PENDING` flag. The software can: 1. confirm the release and transmission of the TX FIFO data by writing a 1 to clear the `TARGET_EVENTS.TX_PENDING` flag; or 2. reset the TX FIFO by writing 1 to `FIFO_CTRL.TXRST` and load in new data via the `TXDATA` register--useful whenthe READ address is targeting a different function of the target. In this mode, the target always sets the `TARGET_EVENTS` register flags.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQ_START_STOP_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: ACQ FIFO Start/Stop Enable (Target Mode only): * `0` - Start/Stop symbols are NOT written into the ACQ FIFO. The firmware should rely on `TARGET_EVENTS.START_DETECT` and `TARGET_EVENTS.STOP_DETECT` flags to detect Start/Stop events. * `1` - Start/Stop symbols ARE written into the ACQ FIFO (legacy behavior). When a START (or repeated START) is detected, an `AcqStart` or `AcqRestart` entry is written. When a STOP is detected, an `AcqStop` or `AcqNackStop` entry is written.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FMTFULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode status: Controller TX FIFO Full.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RXFULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode status: Controller RX FIFO Full.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FMTEMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode status: Controller TX FIFO Empty.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: HOSTIDLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode status: Controller FSM idle.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TARGETIDLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode status: Target FSM idle.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RXEMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode status: Controller RX FIFO empty.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TXFULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode status: Target TX FIFO full.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQFULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode status: Target RX FIFO full.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TXEMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode status: Target TX FIFO empty.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQEMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode status: Target RX FIFO empty.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACK_CTRL_STRETCH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode status: indicates that this target is stretching the clock due to the Software ACK Control Mechanism. See `CTRL.ACK_CTRL_EN` for details.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: RDATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controller RX FIFO Access Register (Controller Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reading this register pops the Controller RX FIFO.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: FDATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controller TX FIFO Access Register (Controller Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FBYTE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing to this register pushes an entry into the Controller TX FIFO. The meaning of this field depends on the value of the `READB` field: * `READB = 0` - This field is the WRITE data byte. * `READB = 1` - This field specifies the number of bytes to read from the target. Setting this field to 0 reads 256 bytes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: START
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Generate a START condition on the bus before sending the byte.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STOP
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Generate a STOP condition on the bus after sending the byte.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READB
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read/write: * `0` - Issue WRITE transaction * `1` - Issue READ transaction

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RCONT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read continue/stop: * `0` — Read Stop: The controller NACKs the last data byte. Use this if this is the last READ in a sequence. * `1` — Read Continue: The controller ACKs the last data byte. Use this if this is an intermediate READ in a sequence.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: NAKOK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: NACK OK. When set, this controller will not care if this byte is NACKed. It will not halt, set the `CONTROLLER_EVENTS.NACK` flag, or assert the `CONTROLLER_HALT` Interrupt. This behavior is useful for protocols like Serial Camera Control Bus (SCCB).

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: FIFO_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: FIFO Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RXRST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode control: writing `1` resets the Controller RX FIFO.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FMTRST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode control: writing `1` resets the Controller TX FIFO.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQRST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode control: writing `1` resets the Target RX FIFO.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TXRST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode control: writing `1` resets the Target TX FIFO.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HOST_FIFO_CONFIG
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controller FIFO Configuration Register (Controller Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_THRESH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The `RX_THRESH` interrupt remains asserted while the Controller RX FIFO level is greater than this setting.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FMT_THRESH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The `FMT_THRESH` interrupt remains asserted while the Controller TX FIFO level is less than this setting.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TARGET_FIFO_CONFIG
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target FIFOs Configuration Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_THRESH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The `TX_THRESH` interrupt remains asserted while the Target TX FIFO level is less than this setting.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQ_THRESH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The `ACQ_THRESH` interrupt remains asserted while the Target RX FIFO level is greater than this setting.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HOST_FIFO_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controller FIFOs Status Register (Controller Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FMTLVL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller TX FIFO fill level.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RXLVL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller RX FIFO fill level.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TARGET_FIFO_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target FIFOs Status Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TXLVL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target TX FIFO fill level.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQLVL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target RX FIFO fill level.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: OVRD
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Override Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TXOVRDEN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: enables control of the SDA and SCL lines through the `SDA_VAL` and `SCL_VAL` fields, respectively.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SCLVAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: SCL override value: * `0` - Pull the SCL line low * `1` - Release the SCL line

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SDAVAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: SDA override value: * `0` - Pull the SDA line low * `1` - Release the SDA line

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: VAL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Bus Oversampled Values Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SCL_RX
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global status: contains the last 16 SCL over-sampled values. LSB is most recent.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SDA_RX
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global status: contains the last 16 SDA over-sampled values. LSB is most recent.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMING0
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: SCL LOW and HIGH Periods Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: THIGH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the HIGH period of SCL (`t_HIGH`) in system clock cycles. Must be `≥ 2`. See Table 11 in the I²C Specification for details. This field is sized to meet the I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s minimum `t_HIGH = 4.0 μs` requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TLOW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the LOW period of SCL (`t_LOW`) in system clock cycles. Must be `≥ 2`. See Table 11 in the I2C Specification for more details. This field is sized to meet the I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz) minimum `t_LOW = 4.7 μs` requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMING1
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Bus Rise and Fall Times Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: T_R
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the rise time of SDA and SCL (`t_r`) in system clock cycles. The rise time is measured from 30% to 70% of the signal swing. See Table 11 in the I2C Specification for more details. This field is sized to meet I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s maximum `t_r = 1000 ns` requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: T_F
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the fall time of SDA and SCL (`t_f`) in system clock cycles. The fall time is measured from 70% to 30% of the signal swing. See Table 11 in the I2C Specification for more details. This field is sized to meet I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s maximum `t_f = 300 ns` requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMING2
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: START Condition Setup and Hold Times Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TSU_STA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the setup time for a repeated START condition (`t_SU;STA`) in system clock cycles. See Table 11 in the I2C Specification for details. This field is sized to meet I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s minimum `t_SU;STA = 4.7 μs` requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: THD_STA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the setup time for a (repeated) START condition (`t_HD;STA`) in system clock cycles. See Table 11 in the I2C Specification for details. This field is sized to meet I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s minimum `t_HD;STA = 4.0 μs` requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMING3
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Data Setup and Hold Times Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TSU_DAT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the data setup time (`t_SU;DAT`) in system clock cycles. See Table 11 in the I2C Specification for details. This field is sized to meet the I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s `t_SU;DAT = 250 ns` minimum requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: THD_DAT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the data and (N)ACK bits hold time (`t_HD;DAT`) in system clock cycles. See Table 11 in the I2C Specification for details. This field is sized to meet the I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s `t_HD;DAT = 5.0 μs` minimum requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMING4
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: STOP Condition Setup Time and Bus Free Time Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TSU_STO
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the setup time for a STOP condition (`t_SU;STO`) in system clock cycles. See Table 11 in the I²C Specification for details. This field is sized to meet I2C Standard-mode (100 kHz)'s `t_SU;STO = 4.0 μs` minimum requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: T_BUF
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: specifies the time between a STOP and START condition (`t_BUF`) in system clock cycles. See Table 11 in the I²C Specification for details. This field is sized to meet I2C Standard-mode (100kHz)'s `t_BUF = 4.7 μs` minimum requirement, assuming a 1 GHz system clock.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMEOUT_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Timeout Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: VAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: Specifies the timeout value in system clock cycles. The meaning of this field depends on `MODE`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MODE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global control: timeout mode. * `0` - Stretch Timeout (Controller Mode only). If the target stretches the clock for more time than `TIMEOUT_CTRL.VAL`, the `STRETCH_TIMEOUT` interrupt will be asserted. * `1` - Bus Timeout. If SCL is LOW for more time than `TIMEOUT_CTRL.VAL`: * In Controller Mode, the `CONTROLLER_EVENTS.BUS_TIMEOUT` flag will be asserted, triggering the `CONTROLLER_HALT` interrupt. * In Target Mode, the `TARGET_EVENTS.BUS_TIMEOUT` flag will be set, triggering the `TX_STRETCH` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Timeout Enable.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TARGET_ID
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target ID Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ADDRESS0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Address 0. This target responds if the 7-bit address matches `ADDRESS0 & MASK0`. `MASK0 = 0x0` disables this address.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MASK0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: ADDRESS0 mask.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ADDRESS1
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Address 1. This target responds if the 7-bit address matches `ADDRESS1 & MASK1`. `MASK1 = 0x0` disables this address.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MASK1
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: ADDRESS1 mask.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ACQDATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target RX FIFO Access Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ABYTE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reading this register pops the ACQ FIFO. The meaning of this field depends on `SIGNAL`: * `SIGNAL = 0x0`, `0x1`, `0x3`, `0x4`, or `0x5` - This field contains an address or data byte sent by the controller. * `SIGNAL = 0x2`, `0x6` - This field is meaningless.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SIGNAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
This field indicates if this FIFO entry represents/is associated with control signal(s): * `0x0` - The entry is an ordinary data byte that has been ACKed. * `0x1` - The entry is an address byte preceded by a START. * `0x2` - The entry is a STOP condition following ACKed data bytes. * `0x3` - The entry is an address byte preceded by a repeated START. * `0x4` - The entry is a NACKed data byte. * `0x5` - The entry is an address byte preceded by a (repeated) START. However, the data bytes that followed this address byte were NACKed. * `0x6` - Error. A transaction preceding ended abnormally, for example, due to an unexpected STOP condition, a Bus or Stretch Timeout, a software NACK, or a lost arbitration.
If the FIFO does not have enough space to record a complete transaction, an Error (`0x6`) entry may appear alone.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TXDATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target TX FIFO Access Register (Target Mode only).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing to this register pushes data into the Target TX FIFO. The controller reads data from this FIFO during a READ transaction.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HOST_TIMEOUT_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controller Timeout Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: VAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target/Monitor Mode control: controller clock generation timeout value specified in system clock cycles. * Target Mode - If the controller stops generating the clock for more time than this setting, this target asserts the Controller Timeout Interrupt. * Monitor Mode - this field is required to be nonzero for the Bus Monitor to transition out of the initial Busy state. Set this field to `0x0` to disable this behavior.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TARGET_TIMEOUT_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target Timeout Control Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: VAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
When this target has stretched the clock for more time than this setting, this target will NACK incoming data bytes or release the SDA line for outgoing data bytes. The count is cumulative over an entire transaction. In other words, this is SMBus's cumulative target clock extension time.
The behavior for the address byte is configurable via `CTRL.NACK_ADDR_AFTER_TIMEOUT`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable Target Timeout.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TARGET_NACK_COUNT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target NACK Count Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TARGET_NACK_COUNT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates the number of transactions NACKed by this target since the last read of this register, saturating at 255. This field can be used to track how many transactions were missed when the Target RX FIFO is full.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TARGET_ACK_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target ACK Control Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: NBYTES
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
When `STATUS.ACK_CTRL_STRETCH = 1`, writing to this register specifies the number of bytes this target should ACK. The count decrements per byte ACKed. Effective only when `CTRL.ACK_CTRL_EN = 1`. See `CTRL.ACK_CTRL_EN` for details.
This control field is used to implement SMBus's mid-transfer (N)ACK responses.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: NACK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When `STATUS.ACK_CTRL_STRETCH = 1`, writing `1` to this field causes this target to NACK all bytes of the transaction. Effective only when `CTRL.ACK_CTRL_EN = 1`.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ACQ_FIFO_NEXT_DATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target RX FIFO Next Byte Register (Target Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: This field contains the next byte to be pushed into the Target RX FIFO, allowing software to decide whether to accept or reject it. Valid only when `STATUS.ACK_CTRL_STRETCH = 1`. See `CTRL.ACK_CTRL_EN` for details.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HOST_NACK_HANDLER_TIMEOUT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controller NACK Timeout Register (Controller Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: VAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Timeout value (specified in system clock cycles) for this controller Mode to automatically STOP a transaction when `CONTROLLER_EVENTS.NACK` is set.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables Controller NACK Timeout.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CONTROLLER_EVENTS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Controller Events Register (Controller Mode only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: NACK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that this controller has halted due to an unexpected NACK sent by the target. This behavior can be disabled by writing `1` to `FDATA.NAKOK`. This bit triggers the `CONTROLLER_HALT` interrupt. Writing `1` clears this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: UNHANDLED_NACK_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that this controller has halted due to a Controller NACK Timeout. See `HOST_NACK_HANDLER_TIMEOUT` for details. This bit triggers the `CONTROLLER_HALT` interrupt. Writing `1` clears this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUS_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that this controller has halted due to a Bus Timeout. See `TIMEOUT_CTRL` for details. This bit triggers the `CONTROLLER_HALT` interrupt. Writing `1` clears this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ARBITRATION_LOST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that the controller has halted due to it losing an arbitration against another controller. This bit triggers the `CONTROLLER_HALT` interrupt. Writing `1` clears this bit.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TARGET_EVENTS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Target Events Register (Target Mode)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_PENDING
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that the target is stretching the clock due to receiving a READ address byte and waiting for software to confirm the release of the Target TX FIFO data. Valid only if `CTRL.TX_STRETCH_CTRL_EN = 1`. See `CTRL.TX_STRETCH_CTRL_EN` for details. This bit triggers the `TX_STRETCH` interrupt. Writing `1` clears this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUS_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that this target has halted due a Bus Timeout terminating a READ transaction. See `TIMEOUT_CTRL` for details. This bit triggers the `TX_STRETCH` interrupt. Writing `1` clears this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ARBITRATION_LOST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that a controller has lost arbitration, causing a READ transaction to end. This bit triggers the `TX_STRETCH` interrupt. Writing `1` clears this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: START_DETECT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Start Detect Flag (Target Mode only). Set to 1 by hardware when a START (or repeated START) is detected while `CTRL.ENABLETARGET = 1`. Cleared when software writes 1.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STOP_DETECT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Stop Detect Flag (Target Mode only). Set to 1 by hardware when a STOP is detected while `CTRL.ENABLETARGET = 1`. Cleared when software writes 1.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SMBUS_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: SMBus Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SMBSUS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode status: indicates that the `smbsus_ni` input is asserted.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SMBALERT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode status: indicates that the `smbalert_ni` input is asserted.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: I2C_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: I2C_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: I2C Enable.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: I2C_CONTROLLER_MODE_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: I2C Controller Mode Enable.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SMBUS_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: SMBus Enable. Gates the SMBus Alert signal.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: UART_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: UART Enable. When set, the pad-mux downstream will be forced to accept UART traffic.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: uart
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Contains the mode-independent registers and the read-only registers accessible only when `DLAB = 0`.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: RBR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Receiver Buffer Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Received Data. Contains a received character. If FIFOs are enabled, this field points to the bottom of the RX FIFO. Otherwise, this field points to a single- byte Receiver Buffer Register.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: IER
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Enable Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ERBFI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable Receiver Buffer Full (Received Data Ready) Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ETBEI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable Transmitter Buffer Empty (Transmitter Holding Register Empty) Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ELSI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable (Receiver) Line Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EDSSI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable (Delta Status of) Modem Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EFEI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable FIFO Error Interrupt.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: IIR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Identification Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: INTERRUPT_PENDING
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Interrupt Pending. Active-low.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: INTERRUPT_ID
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Interrupt ID: * `0x7` - FIFO Error Interrupt (priority 0) * `0x3` - Receiver Line Status Interrupt (priority 1) * `0x6` - Reception Timeout Interrupt (priority 2) * `0x2` - Received Data Ready Interrupt (priority 3) * `0x1` - Transmitter Holding Register Empty Interrupt (priority 4) * `0x0` - Modem Status Interrupt (priority 5)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FIFOS_ENABLED
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: FIFOs Enabled: * `0x0` - FIFOs are disabled * `0x3` - FIFOs are enabled

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: LCR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Line Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: WLS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Word Length Select: * `0x0` - 5 bits per character * `0x1` - 6 bits per character * `0x2` - 7 bits per character * `0x3` - 8 bits per character

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STB
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Stop Bits: * `0` - 1 stop bit. * `1` - 2 stop bits (or 1.5 stop bits if word length is set to 5 bits)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PEN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Parity Enable.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EPS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Even Parity Select: * `1` - even parity * `0` - odd parity

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STICK_PARITY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Stick Parity. If set, forces the transmit and received parity bits to be `0` if even parity is selected and `1` if odd parity is selected.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SET_BREAK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Set Break. If set, forces the `tx_o` output to `0` to cause a break condition on the receiving UART.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DLAB
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Divisor Latch Access Bit. If set, allows access to the `DLL` and `DLM` registers when accessing addresses `0x0` and `0x4`, respectively. If unset, allows access to the `THR`, `RBR`, and `IIR` registers.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: MCR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Modem Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DTR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Data Terminal Ready. Writing to this bit drives the `dtr_no` output in the opposite polarity.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RTS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Request to Send. Writing to this bit drives the `rts_no` output in the opposite polarity.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: OUT1
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: User Output 1. Writing to this bit drives the `out1_no` in the opposite polarity.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: OUT2
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: User Output 2. Writing to this bit drives the `out2_no` in the opposite polarity.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOOP
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: System Loopback. If set, the transmitter is internally connected to the receiver. The `tx_o` output is set to `1`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LINE_LOOPBACK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Line Loopback. If set, the `rx_i` input is internally connected to the `tx_o` output.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: LSR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Line Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Data Ready. When set, indicates that the RX FIFO (or RBR in non-FIFO mode) contains data.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: OE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Overrun Error. When set, indicates that the RX FIFO (or Receiver Buffer Register in Non-FIFO Mode) is full when new character is received. In FIFO Mode, the new character is dropped. In non-FIFO mode, the existing character in the RBR is overwritten. This bit triggers the Receiver Line Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Parity Error. When set, indicates that the character at the top of the receiver FIFO (or RBR in non-FIFO mode) has a parity error. This bit triggers the Receiver Line Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Framing Error. When set, indicates that the received character is missing a stop bit. In FIFO mode, this bit is set when the character reaches the top of the FIFO. In non-FIFO mode, this bit is set when the character enters the RBR. This bit triggers the Receiver Line Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Break Interrupt. When set, indicates that the `rx_i` input is `0` for an entire frame's time (start + data + parity + stop bits). In FIFO mode, this bit set when the character reaches the top of the receiver FIFO. In non-FIFO mode, this bit is set when the character enters the RBR. This bit triggers the Receiver Line Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: THRE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Transmitter Holding Register Empty. When set, indicates that the TX FIFO (or THR in non-FIFO mode) is empty. Clearing the Transmitter Holding Register Empty Interrupt does NOT clear this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TEMT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Transmitter Empty. When set, indicates that the transmitter shift register and the transmitter FIFO (or THR in non-FIFO mode) are empty.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ERROR_IN_RCVR_FIFO
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Error in Receiver FIFO. When set, indicates that the receiver FIFO or (RBR in non-FIFO mode) has the parity, framing, or break error. In other words, at least one of the PE, FE, and BI bits is set.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: MSR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Modem Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DCTS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Delta Clear to Send. When set, indicates that the `CTS` bit has changed since the last time this register was read. This bit triggers the Modem Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DDSR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Delta Data Set Ready. When set, indicates that the `DSR` bit has changed since the last time this register was read. This bit triggers the Modem Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TERI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Trailing Edge Ring Indicator. When set, indicates that the `RI` bit has changed from a `1` to a `0`. This bit triggers the Modem Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DDCD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Delta Data Carrier Detect. When set, indicates that the `DCD` bit has changed since the last time this register was read. This bit triggers the Modem Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CTS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear to Send. This bit reflects the `cts_ni` input in the opposite polarity, so it reads `1` while the remote device is ready to receive data.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DSR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Data Set Ready. This bit reflects the `dsr_ni` input in the opposite polarity, so it reads `1` while the remote modem is connected and ready.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Ring Indicator. This bit reflects the `ri_ni` input in the opposite polarity, so it reads `1` while the remote modem signals an incoming call.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DCD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Data Carrier Detect. This bit reflects the `dcd_ni` input in the opposite polarity, so it reads `1` while a carrier is detected.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SCR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Scratch Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SCR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Scratch. Holds user data.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ECR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Extended Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RCVR_TRIGGER_MS2B
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Receiver FIFO Trigger Level Most Significant 2 Bits. To configure the least significant 2 bits, use the `FCR.RCVR_TRIGGER` register field. The configurations for the trigger levels are: * `0x0` - 1 character * `0x1` - 4 characters * `0x2` - 8 characters * `0x3` - 14 characters * `0x4` - 32 characters * `0x5` - 64 characters * `0x6` - 128 characters * `0x7` - 256 characters * `0x8` - 512 characters * `0x9` - 1024 characters * `0xA` - 2048 characters * `0xB` - 4096 characters

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ITR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Test Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TRBFI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Test Receiver Buffer Full (Received Data Ready) Interrupt. Writing `1` forces the interrupt and writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TTBEI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Test Transmitter Buffer Empty (Transmitter Holding Register Empty) Interrupt. Writing `1` forces the interrupt and writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TLSI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Test (Receiver) Line Status Interrupt. Writing `1` forces the interrupt and writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TDSSI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Test (Delta Status of) Modem Status Interrupt. Writing `1` forces the interrupt and writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TFEI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Test FIFO Error Interrupt. Writing `1` forces the interrupt and writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TRTI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Test Reception Timeout Interrupt. Writing a `1` forces the interrupt and writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: log_engine
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Log Engine

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Engine Enable. When set, enables the Log Engine. When unset, disables the Log Engine and resets all FSMs, flops, and FIFOs.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: LOG_REGION_SIZE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Log Region Size Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_REGION_SIZE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Region Size. Specified in bytes. Needs to be a multiple of 16.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: LOG_REGION_ADDR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Log Region Address Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_REGION_ADDR_LO
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Region Start Address Low.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_REGION_ADDR_HI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Region Start Address High.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: LOG_WRITE_ADDR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Log Write Address Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_WRITE_ADDR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Write Address. This is the address where the log data is written to.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_FETCH_ERR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Fetch Error Interrupt. Asserted when the bus for fetching log data returns an error.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_WRITE_ERR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Write Error Interrupt. Asserted when the bus for writing log data returns an error.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_ENABLE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Enable Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_FETCH_ERR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Fetch Error Interrupt Enable.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_WRITE_ERR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Write Error Interrupt Enable.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_TEST
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Test Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_FETCH_ERR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Fetch Error Interrupt Test. Writing `1` forces the interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_WRITE_ERR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Write Error Interrupt Test. Writing `1` forces the interrupt.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: LOG_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Log Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_LEN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Length. Writing a nonzero value representing the log length in bytes to this field starts the log transfer process. There are 16 copies of this register, each representing a log entry. The log entries go through round robin arbitration.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_efuse_map
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:displayName: Efuse address map of physical efuse macro
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Address map for efuse shadow registers providing access to various chip configuration and ID fields

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: LOCKS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Lock controls for each fuse field. When write locked, the corresponding field is not programmable. When read locked, the shadow register is not readable.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: jtag_public_identity_write_lock
