ipxact:register.ipxact:name: JTAG_PUBLIC_IDENTITY
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: JTAG-public exception window. In PROD and RMA_SiP, JTAG reads of this range are admitted while JTAG access to every other fuse field is blocked. Encoding is adopter-defined; the harness does not interpret or consume the value. The slot-0 read lock still hides the bits when set.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: value
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Opaque payload. Encoding is adopter-defined; the harness does not interpret it.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: I2C_I3C_ID
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: I2C/I3C interface ID

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: interface_id
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: I2C or I3C ID configuration: * Static ID mode: [6:0] contains ID, [63:7] reserved * Provisional ID mode: [63:0] full ID

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SMC_CONFIG
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: SMC boot and configuration controls sourced from fuse. Only the low word carries assigned bits, so firmware reads it as a single 32-bit access.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rom_flip_endianness
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, the ROM interface swaps byte order on instruction fetch.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: config_rsvd_low
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved for future configuration bits.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: sram_auto_zero_disable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, boot skips the SRAM auto-zero initialisation pass.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: config_rsvd_mid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved for future configuration bits.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: dft_ignore_error
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, boot continues despite a reported memory repair or MBIST failure.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: config_rsvd_high
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved for future configuration bits.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: OCCP_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: OCCP transport timeout in the low word; upper word reserved.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: timeout
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Transport timeout value consumed by the boot ROM OCCP driver.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: timeout_rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved for extension of the timeout encoding.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: SPARE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Individually lockable 256-bit spare region, reserved for fields assigned after the RTL is frozen. Each element has its own write/read lock pair in LOCKS.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Spare fuse bits for future use.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: EFUSE_INTERFACE_CTRL_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: eFuse interface status and error-clear register. Reports the sense-done flag and request/address error conditions, and provides write-1 strobes to clear those errors.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_sense_done
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates if the eFuse state machine has completed

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_req_error
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that the eFuse was blocked because of either read or a program lock. The error must be cleared by writing 1 to efuse_req_error_clear to this register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_program_addr_error
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that an invalid eFuse program address was used (address exceeds the implemented eFuse size). The error must be cleared by writing 1 to efuse_program_addr_error_clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_read_addr_error
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that an invalid eFuse read address was used (address exceeds the implemented eFuse size). The error must be cleared by writing 1 to efuse_read_addr_error_clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_req_error_clear
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clears the blocked request error bit in efuse_ctrl_status

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_program_addr_error_clear
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clears the program out of bounds error bit (efuse_program_addr_error) in efuse_ctrl_status

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_read_addr_error_clear
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clears the read out of bounds error bit (efuse_read_addr_error) in efuse_ctrl_status

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: EFUSE_PROGRAM_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: eFuse program control and status. Configures the program address and data, triggers a program (optionally with read-back), and reports program progress and completion status.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_addr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Bit address to program

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_data
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Data to program to eFuse. If this bit is 0, the program request will be ignored

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_program_go
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, triggers a program to the eFuse. This will be ignored if the lock bit is set

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_program_read_back
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, trigger a read back after a program

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: program_busy
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, the program is in progress

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: program_done
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, the program has completed, the status of which is in program_status

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: program_status
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 0: No Error. 1: Error

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: program_enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, enables the program request

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: EFUSE_READ_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: eFuse read control and status. Configures the read address, triggers a read, and reports read progress and completion status.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_addr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Bit address to read

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: efuse_read_go
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, triggers a read to efuse.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_busy
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, the read is in progress

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_done
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, the read has completed, the status of which is in read_status

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_status
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 0: No Error. 1: Logic error, assert read_go when read is not enabled

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, enables the read request

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: EFUSE_PROGRAM_INTERFACE_READ_DATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Read data captured through the program interface. Hardware debug only; valid only while the program interface state machine is in its capture-data state.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: dout
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read Data from eFuse through program interface. This field is only valid when the efuse programming interface is utilized to burn the efuse IP and only when the state machine is during ST_CAPTUER_DATA state. Hardware debug only

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: EFUSE_READ_INTERFACE_READ_DATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Read data returned through the eFuse read interface.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: dout
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read Data from eFuse through READ interface.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: EFUSE_READ_REQ_TIMEOUT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Read interface timeout configuration. Sets the number of cycles the read interface waits for a SHIM response and enables the read timeout.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_req_timeout_cycles
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of cycles the read interface will wait for a response from the shim. At 100MHz this can count ~= 2.5 seconds.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_req_timout_enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable timeout on read interface

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: EFUSE_PROGRAM_REQ_TIMEOUT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Program interface timeout configuration. Sets the number of cycles the program interface waits for a SHIM response and enables the program timeout.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: program_req_timeout_cycles
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of cycles the program interface will wait for a response from the shim. At 100MHz this can count ~= 2.5 seconds.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: program_req_timeout_enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable timeout on program interface.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: telemetry_receiver
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Telemetry Receiver

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUFFER_POP
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Telemetry Message Buffer Pop. Effective only if `STATUS.BUFFER_EMPTY = 0`. Writing `1` pops the buffer and thus updates the data in the `TELEMETRY_PROBE_ID`, `TELEMETRY_COUNTER_VLDS`, and `TELEMETRY_COUNTER[32]` registers.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TELEMETRY_RX_FLUSH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Telemetry Receiver Flush. Writing `1` flushes the Telemetry Receiver Buffer and all other storage elements in the Telemetry Receiver.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TELEMETRY_TX_FLUSH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Telemetry Transmitter Flush. Writing `1` flushes all FIFOs in the telemetry transmitter. The flushing is done via the ATB AF interface. This bit clears itself after the flush completes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUFFER_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Telemetry Message Buffer Threshold. The Telemetry Buffer Threshold Interrupt is asserted when the number of entries in the buffer is greater than this value.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUFFER_EMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Telemetry Message Buffer Empty.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUFFER_FULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Telemetry Message Buffer Full.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MISSING_LAST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Last Packet Missing Interrupt. Asserted when the Telemetry Receiver has not received a Last Packet flag when the maximum number of packets a message can consist of has been received.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUFFER_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Telemetry Message Buffer Threshold Interrupt. Asserted when the number of telemetry messages in the Telemetry Message Buffer is greater than `CTRL.BUFFER_THRESHOLD`.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_ENABLE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Enable Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MISSING_LAST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Last Packet Missing Interrupt Enable.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUFFER_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Telemetry Message Buffer Threshold Interrupt Enable.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_TEST
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Test Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MISSING_LAST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Last Packet Missing Interrupt Test. Writing `1` forces the interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BUFFER_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Telemetry Message Buffer Threshold Interrupt Test. Writing `1` forces the interrupt and writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TELEMETRY_PROBE_ID
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Telemetry Probe ID Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PROBE_ID
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Probe ID. Contains the Probe ID field of the telemetry message at the bottom of the Telemetry Message Buffer.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TELEMETRY_COUNTER_VLDS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Telemetry Counter Valid Bits Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: COUNTER_VLDS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Counter Valid Bits. Indicates which of the counter values in the telemetry message at the bottom of the Telemetry Message Buffer are valid. Bit `i` is for the `i`-th counter.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TELEMETRY_COUNTER
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Telemetry Counter Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: COUNTER
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Counter Value. Contains one of the 32 counter values in the telemetry message at the bottom of the Telemetry Message Buffer.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_system_timer_octs
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Open Chiplet Time Synchronization (OCTS) System Timer Registers

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMER_START
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: System Timer Start Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: START
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Start the system timer. Asserts the sync_load signal to start synchronization (only does anything if primary mode). Ensure both primary and secondary are out of reset.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: System Timer Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CREDIT_VAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Credit value factor. WARNING: This value must be greater than PULSE_WIDTH

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PULSE_WIDTH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Pulse width for sync load and credit signals. A value of 0 will be rounded up to 1. WARNING: This value must be less than CREDIT_VAL

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STEP
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Step amount for secondary timer

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: System Timer Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MODE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Timer mode: 0=PRIMARY, 1=SECONDARY (set by module parameter)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RUNNING
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Timer is currently enabled and running

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMER_PRESET_LO
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: System Timer Preset Value [31:0]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PRESET_LO
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Lower 32 bits of preset value

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMER_PRESET_HI
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: System Timer Preset Value [63:32]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PRESET_HI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Upper 32 bits of preset value

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMER_COUNT_LO
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Current System Timer Count [31:0]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: COUNT_LO
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Lower 32 bits of current timer count

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMER_COUNT_HI
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Current System Timer Count [63:32]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: COUNT_HI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Upper 32 bits of current timer count

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CREDIT_EXPIRED
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Credit Expired Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MAX_CYCLES_EXPIRED
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Maximum number of clock cycles since a count credit expired (SECONDARY only). To reset the value of this register, write anything to it. If this number is very high (exact value depends on clock speed and credit value), this indicates that the secondary has not recieved a count credit pulse in a while, and is likely not syncing properly with the primary. This register can also be used to determine the clock skew between the primary and secondary. If PRIMARY, this field is always 0.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: TIMER_GPIO_ENABLE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: System Timer GPIO Enable Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: GPIO_ENABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable the GPIO pad lsio interface for the system timer. This is done to prevent X-prop on reset into the secondary timer, which can cause the secondary timer to start counting early.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: mem_repair_done
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: One bit indicator from DFT logic to say when mem repair is completed. This register is sticky 1 and will hold the value until reset

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: mem_repair_success
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: One bit indicator from DFT logic to say if mem repair was successful This register is sticky 1 and will hold the value until reset

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: mem_repair_abort
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: One bit indicator from DFT logic to say that mem repair has hit timeout and aborted This register is sticky 1 and will hold the value until reset

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: mbist_done
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: One bit indicator from DFT logic to say when MBIST is completed This register is sticky 1 and will hold the value until reset

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: mbist_pass
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: One bit indicator from DFT logic to say when MBIST is successful This register is sticky 1 and will hold the value until reset

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: mbist_abort
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: One bit indicator from DFT logic to say that MBIST has hit timeout and aborted This register is sticky 1 and will hold the value until reset

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: chiplet_enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Chiplet Enable Used for Triggering

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: gpio_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: GPIO en

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clock gating en

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: force_clk_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Force clk en

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: dtb_ns_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: DTB NS enable

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: dtb_ew_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: DTB E/W enable

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: xtrig_clk_halt_mask
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mask==0 (default) -> disabled; Mask==1 -> enabled

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: debug_marker
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Debug marker

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Dbmmode
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mode selection, 0: DBM off, 1: Normal debug mode, 2: DBM ID output mode, 3: Toggle Mode

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Dbmid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Unique DBM ID of the DBM instance

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mux Select Bits for Lane 0. Split debug bus into 16 bit segments. Seg0 = debug bus [15:0], Seg1 = debug bus[31:16],.... If all bits are 0, Lane0 = Seg0, if bit[0] = 1, Lane0 = Seg4, if bit[1] =1, Lane0 = Seg5,...

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg1
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mux Select Bits for Lane 1. Split debug bus into 16 bit segments. Seg0 = debug bus [15:0], Seg1 = debug bus[31:16],.... If all bits are 0, Lane1= Seg1, if bit[0] = 1, Lane1 = Seg4, if bit[1] =1, Lane1 = Seg5,...

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg2
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mux Select Bits for Lane 2. Split debug bus into 16 bit segments. Seg0 = debug bus [15:0], Seg1 = debug bus[31:16],.... If all bits are 0, Lane2= Seg2, if bit[0] = 1, Lane2 = Seg4, if bit[1] =1, Lane2 = Seg5,...

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg3
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mux Select Bits for Lane 3. Split debug bus into 16 bit segments. Seg0 = debug bus [15:0], Seg1 = debug bus[31:16],.... If all bits are 0, Lane3= Seg3, if bit[0] = 1, Lane3 = Seg4, if bit[1] =1, Lane3 = Seg5,...

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: base
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Global base address for the CPU

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: base
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Local base address for the CPU

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: size
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Region size for SMC resources. Defaults to 16MB (0x100_0000); FW reprograms per chiplet spec.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: dma_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clockgate enable for the DMA

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: mailbox_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clockgate enable for the mailbox

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: filter_ob_axi_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clockgate enable for the outbound filters

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: filter_ob_reg_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clockgate enable for outbound filter registers

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: filter_ib_axi_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clockgate enable for the inbound filters

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: filter_ib_reg_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clockgate enable for inbound filter registers

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: addr_remap_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clock gate enable for address remapper register logic

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: output_fabric_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clock gate enable for address remapper register logic

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: zeroer_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clock gate enable for axi zeroer

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: i3c_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clock gate enable for i3c

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: avs_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clock gate enable for AVSBus

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: i2c_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clock gate enable for i2c

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: uart_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clock gate enable for UART

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: telemetry_cg_en
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clock gate enable for telemetry

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cg_hysteresis
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clockgate cg_hysteresis

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HANG_DET_SYS_AXI_CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: AXI hang detector control.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: enable

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: HANG_DET_SYS_AXI_TIMEOUT_THRESHOLD

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: value
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Threshold in clock cycles. Default 0x1000. 20 bits => up to ~1M cycles (~1ms at 1GHz).

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_alias_remap
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: TLB Registers for address remapping and attribute tagging

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: start_addr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Start of remap region

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: end_addr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: End of remap region (non-inclusive).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: offset
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The value of this field is added to bits [55:12] of the input address when it falls within the remap region. The lower 12 bits of the address are preserved unchanged.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cacheable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: If set, top two bits of a*cache will be tied high

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: valid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: If set, this remap will be active

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_mmode_remap
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: TLB Registers for address remapping and attribute tagging

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: offset
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Address translation for remap region. RTL will use the number of bits appropriate for region granulaity. e.g. SMC: 8 * 1MB regions --> 20 bits of address space per region, 36 MSBs from this register used SEP: 16 * 512KB regions --> 19 bits of address space per region, 37 MSBs from this register used

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_xvisor_remap

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_inbound_filter_ctrl
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Filter control registers. One per filter

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_allowed
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Filter range has read permissions

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: write_allowed
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Filter range has write permissions

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: entry_enabled
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Filter entry enabled. A = 0 means this entry is disabled, A = 1 means this entry is enabled and will be used to filter

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: allow_ns
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Only transactions with axprot[1] equal to this field will be allowed to pass

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data_bus_width
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Data bus width in bytes, encoded as 2^value

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: src_id
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Source Id field to match to pass filter

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: group_id
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Group Id field to match to pass filter

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: allow_burst
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Allow burst transactions through this filter

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: locked
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Lock filter configurations. Write once register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: start_addr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Start of allowable address range

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: end_addr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: End of allowable address range. Defaults to 7 on reset to match the minimum granularity when burst is disabled

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: write_data
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write data to mailbox fifo

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_data
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read data from mailbox fifo

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: empty
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 0: Data is available to read, 1: Data is not available to read

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: full
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 0: Space is available to write, 1: Space is not available to write

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: write_level_above_thresh
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: If set, write fifo level is higher than threshhold set in WIRQT

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_level_above_thresh
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: If set, read fifo level is higher than threshhold set in RIRQT

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_error
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Attempted read from an empty mailbox

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: write_error
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Attempted write to a full mailbox

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: wirqt
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When the usage pointer of the FIFO connected to the W channel exceeds this value, a write threshold IRQ is triggered and the corresponding STATUS register bit is set. When a value larger than or equal to the MailboxDepth parameter is written to this register, it gets reduced to MailboxDepth - 1 to ensure an IRQ is triggered when the write FIFO is full.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rirqt
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When the fill pointer of the FIFO connected to the R channel exceeds this value, a read threshold IRQ is triggered and the corresponding STATUS register bit is set. When a value larger than or equal to the MailboxDepth parameter is written to this register, it gets reduced to MailboxDepth - 1 to ensure an IRQ is triggered when the read FIFO is full.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: IRQS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: This register is used to read and clear interrupt requests, regardless of IRQEN register and whether the interrupt is enabled or disabled.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: wtirq
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: On read: [0]: No interrupt request [1]: Usage level threshold in write mailbox exceeded On write: [0]: No acknowledge [1]: Acknowledge and clear interrupt request

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rtirq
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: On read: [0]: No interrupt request [1]: Usage level threshold in read mailbox exceeded On write: [0]: No acknowledge [1]: Acknowledge and clear interrupt request

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: eirq
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: On read: [0]: No interrupt request [1]: Error on mailbox access On write: [0]: No acknowledge [1]: Acknowledge and clear interrupt request

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: IRQEN
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: This register is used to enable and disable which interrupts are sent to the CPU.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: wtirq
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: [0]: Write threshold IRQ disabled [1]: Write threshold IRQ enabled

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rtirq
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: [0]: Read threshold IRQ disabled [1]: Read threshold IRQ enabled

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: eirq
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: [0]: Error IRQ disabled [1]: Error IRQ enabled

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: IRQP
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: This register is used to read the current status of the interrupts sent to the CPU.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: wtirq
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: [0]: No write threshold IRQ pending [1]: Write threshold IRQ pending

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rtirq

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: eirq
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: [0]: No error IRQ pending [1]: Error IRQ pending

ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Flush the read FIFO for this port

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: write_data
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write data to mailbox fifo

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_data
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read data from mailbox fifo

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: empty
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 0: Data is available to read, 1: Data is not available to read

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: full
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 0: Space is available to write, 1: Space is not available to write

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: write_level_above_thresh
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: If set, write fifo level is higher than threshhold set in WIRQT

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_level_above_thresh
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: If set, read fifo level is higher than threshhold set in RIRQT

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_error
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Attempted read from an empty mailbox

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: write_error
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Attempted write to a full mailbox

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: wirqt
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When the usage pointer of the FIFO connected to the W channel exceeds this value, a write threshold IRQ is triggered and the corresponding STATUS register bit is set. When a value larger than or equal to the MailboxDepth parameter is written to this register, it gets reduced to MailboxDepth - 1 to ensure an IRQ is triggered when the write FIFO is full.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rirqt
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When the fill pointer of the FIFO connected to the R channel exceeds this value, a read threshold IRQ is triggered and the corresponding STATUS register bit is set. When a value larger than or equal to the MailboxDepth parameter is written to this register, it gets reduced to MailboxDepth - 1 to ensure an IRQ is triggered when the read FIFO is full.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: IRQS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: This register is used to read and clear interrupt requests, regardless of IRQEN register and whether the interrupt is enabled or disabled.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: wtirq
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: On read: [0]: No interrupt request [1]: Usage level threshold in write mailbox exceeded On write: [0]: No acknowledge [1]: Acknowledge and clear interrupt request

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rtirq
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: On read: [0]: No interrupt request [1]: Usage level threshold in read mailbox exceeded On write: [0]: No acknowledge [1]: Acknowledge and clear interrupt request

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: eirq
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: On read: [0]: No interrupt request [1]: Error on mailbox access On write: [0]: No acknowledge [1]: Acknowledge and clear interrupt request

ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reset control for the CPU, active low.

ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reset control for the CPU, active low.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: core0_reset_pulse_start_n0_scan
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing a 1 to this register triggers a core reset pulse, the duration of which is set by CORE_RESET_PULSE_COUNT. This pulse is ANDed with core_reset_n[0] so a 0 in core_reset_n[0] will override the pulse.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: core1_reset_pulse_start_n0_scan
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing a 1 to this register triggers a core reset pulse, the duration of which is set by CORE_RESET_PULSE_COUNT. This pulse is ANDed with core_reset_n[1] so a 0 in core_reset_n[1] will override the pulse.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: core2_reset_pulse_start_n0_scan
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing a 1 to this register triggers a core reset pulse, the duration of which is set by CORE_RESET_PULSE_COUNT. This pulse is ANDed with core_reset_n[2] so a 0 in core_reset_n[2] will override the pulse.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: core3_reset_pulse_start_n0_scan
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing a 1 to this register triggers a core reset pulse, the duration of which is set by CORE_RESET_PULSE_COUNT. This pulse is ANDed with core_reset_n[3] so a 0 in core_reset_n[3] will override the pulse.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: uncore_reset_n_n0_scan
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Cluster Uncore Reset, active low. Writing this register will only reset the uncore portion in the chipyard cluster. WARNING: using this can cause any outstanding axi requests to and from the cluster to cause timeouts/exceptions.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: debug_reset_n_n0_scan
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Debug Module Reset, active low

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: pre_reset_count
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Core reset pulse count pre-reset. The duration of the pulse is the set value + 1.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: post_reset_count
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Core reset pulse count post-reset. The duration of the pulse is the set value + 1.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: core_resets_done
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Logic low while performing core reset, logic high otherwise.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: timeout_value
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Cycles (clk_smc) a software reset may stay pending (withheld, waiting for drain) before timeout. 0 = disabled, wait indefinitely.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: timeout_mode
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Timeout mode: 0 = give up and report error (stay withheld, do not apply); 1 = force the reset on timeout.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: reset_applied
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Live status: high while a requested software reset is actually applied at the cluster (drain complete and reset asserted).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: reset_timeout
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Live status: high while a pending software reset has exceeded timeout_value (timeout/error flag; set in both modes).

ipxact:field.ipxact:description: HW mutex. Reads will attempt to acquire mutex, 1 on success. If the mutex is already acquired, the read will return 0. To release the mutex, write any value to the register.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: sema
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 16-bit semaphore value to inc/dec. Writing to this register will inc/dec the semaphore value. The written value is treated as a signed number using 2s compliment.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Dbmmode
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mode selection, 0: DBM off, 1: Normal debug mode, 2: DBM ID output mode, 3: Toggle Mode

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Dbmid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Unique DBM ID of the DBM instance

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mux Select Bits for Lane 0. Split debug bus into 16 bit segments. Seg0 = debug bus [15:0], Seg1 = debug bus[31:16],.... If all bits are 0, Lane0 = Seg0, if bit[0] = 1, Lane0 = Seg4, if bit[1] =1, Lane0 = Seg5,...

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg1
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mux Select Bits for Lane 1. Split debug bus into 16 bit segments. Seg0 = debug bus [15:0], Seg1 = debug bus[31:16],.... If all bits are 0, Lane1= Seg1, if bit[0] = 1, Lane1 = Seg4, if bit[1] =1, Lane1 = Seg5,...

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg2
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mux Select Bits for Lane 2. Split debug bus into 16 bit segments. Seg0 = debug bus [15:0], Seg1 = debug bus[31:16],.... If all bits are 0, Lane2= Seg2, if bit[0] = 1, Lane2 = Seg4, if bit[1] =1, Lane2 = Seg5,...

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg3
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mux Select Bits for Lane 3. Split debug bus into 16 bit segments. Seg0 = debug bus [15:0], Seg1 = debug bus[31:16],.... If all bits are 0, Lane3= Seg3, if bit[0] = 1, Lane3 = Seg4, if bit[1] =1, Lane3 = Seg5,...

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Timestamp
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Timestamp value

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TimestampSync
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: TimestampSync value

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TsSync
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: TS Sync

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DebugMarker
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Debug Marker

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Rsvd

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Trdstsyncmode
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When the field is set tp 2'b10, sent timestamp. All other vlaues not NA.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Trdstsyncmax
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When trDstSyncMode is set to 2'b10, timestamp will be sent for every 2^(trDstSyncMax + 4) Cluster clocks.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Trdstformat
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: bit[0]: XOR Enable, bit[1]: VLT Enable. Supported values : 2'b3 (XOR+VLT Compression), 2'b1 (XOR Compresion), 2'b0 (No Compression)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Trdstvendorframelength
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Specify frame length. Frame Length = trDstVendorFrameLength* 64 ; Frame Length should be a multiple of Bank Data Width.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Trdstvendorstreamlength
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Specify Stream length. A stream starts with "no compressed packet". Stream length specifies number of frames before a non-compressed packet is sent.Stream Length = 32* 2^(trDstVendorStreamLength + 1)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TraceSourceId
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Trace Source ID (FIXME: Base Address, Tool Issue)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TraceFrameFillByte
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Use "Filler Packet" to align a stream of trace packets within a frame boundary.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FrameLenghtInBytes
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Use trDstImpl[trDstVendorFrameLength] for Frame Length programming. Register field ZBB-ed.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FrameModeEnable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable Frame Mode (Frame Mode: Always pack "frame length" number of bytes for trace transmission). If flush to memory is stalled (due to silicon bug), we can have incomplete packets in memory. Frame Mode will help SW decoder to avoid reading incomplete trasnmitted packets. In Frame Mode, SW will get a memory pointer that is aligned to Frame Length. HW will ensure there are no incomplete packets incluced in the region pointed by memory pointer.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FrameClosureMode
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Closure Mode: 1: Close frame with a packet no larger than max packet size before any overflow (due to packets crossing frame boundary). 0: Close frame when packets cross boundary. Push back packet crossing frame boundary to packet generator.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CDbgClaCounter0Cfg
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Configure CLA counter0. One of the 4 counters used for counting cycles after a event match, and trigger a action on match.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ResetOnTarget
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When Counter = {upper_target,target} reset to 0. With this bit set, counter will provide a periodic tick w/ frequency of (target +1) if the action is set to Auto Incr. The periodic tick will continue till Stop Auto Incr or Clear Counter action.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CDbgSignalEdgeDetectCfg

ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Define which signal to select for edge detection.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PosEdgeSignal0

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Signal1Select

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CDbgEapStatus
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Register to indicate if EAP Pair was activated. Use the corresponding w2c register to reset the status. There are 2 bits for each EAP. The bit corresponds to action-0 and action-1 of the EAP. The register is used by SW to know if an action was taken (ex: NMI ISR needs to know which of the EAP triggered the NMI)

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CDbgClaCtrlStatus
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Ctrl/Status register to Enable EAP after EAP programming is complete, and read the current node.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CurrentNode
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read the current node.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EnableEap
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Set Enable EAP to 1 after EAP programming is complete

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EnableCla
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Set this bit to 1 to enable CLA. If this bit is set, CLA is clock gated (save pwr)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ClaChainLoopDelay
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Creates a window in which we don’t forward the incoming Xtrigger and Clock_Halt signal

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DisableGlobalClockHalt
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: If this bit is set, clock halt action is not applied to global clocks

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DisableLocalClockHalt
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: If this bit is set, clock halt action is not applied to local clocks

ipxact:register.ipxact:description: 3 registers to configure "transition event". This register is to select the signals of interest using a mask.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CDbgTransitionFromValue
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: 3 registers to configure "transition event". The event is triggered on transition from Value A to Value B. This register specifies Value A.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CDbgTransitionToValue
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: 3 registers to configure "transition event". The event is triggered on transition from Value A to Value B. This register specifies Value B.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CDbgOnesCountMask
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: 2 registers to configure "ones count" event. This register is to select the signals of interest using a mask.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CDbgOnesCountValue
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: 2 registers to configure "ones count" event. Event triggered when the sum of the signals match the value specified in this register.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CDbgAnyChange
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Event triggered when a subset of debug signals change. The mask is used to select the subset of the debug signals.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CDbgClaTimeMatch
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: This value is compared (greater than or equal to the programmed value) against the internal time register value of the core, and is used to generate a time match event for CLA.
